harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: His saying «عمّ»: composed of the genitive preposition «عن» and the interrogative «ما» whose alif has been dropped; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يتساءلون».

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The preposition «عن النبأ» is a badal (substitute) of the preposition before it and is attached to what it is attached to.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «الذي»: naʿt (adjective) of «نبأ»; the preposition «فيه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) «مختلفون».

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: (كلا سيعلمون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: (ثم كلا سيعلمون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is conjoined to the resumptive one before it.

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: «الجبال»: a noun conjoined to {الأَرْضَ}; «أوتادا»: a noun conjoined to {مِهَادًا}.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The clause «وخلقناكم» is conjoined to the earlier clause {أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ}; «أزواجا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «لنخرج» is genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أنزلنا».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The singular of «ألفاف» is لِفّ, and it is a naʿt (adjective) of «جنات».

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: His saying «يوم»: a badal (substitute) of {يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ}; the preposition «في الصور» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause «فتأتون» is conjoined to «ينفخ»; and «أفواجا»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «تأتون».

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The clause «وفتحت» is conjoined to the clause {يُنْفَخُ}.

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The preposition «للطاغين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of {مِرْصَادًا}; «مآبا»: second khabar (predicate) of «كان».

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: His saying «لابثين»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الطاغين»; the preposition «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «لابثين»; «أحقابا»: an adverb attached to «لابثين».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The clause «لا يذوقون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in {لابِثِينَ}, i.e.: remaining, not tasting.

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: (إلا حميما وغساقا) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] Connected excepted (mustathnā muttaṣil) from {شَرَابًا}.

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: «جزاء»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e.: they are recompensed with a recompense; and «وفاقا» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: «كِذَّابا»: maṣdar (verbal noun) of كذّبوا; the maṣdar of فَعَّل is التفعيل and الفِعّال.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The wāw is a conjunction; «كلَّ»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "أحصينا"; the implied clause is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا}, and the clause «أحصيناه» is explicative; «كتابا»: nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq (substitute for the absolute object), and this maṣdar is synonymous in meaning with its governing word.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The clause «فذوقوا» is resumptive, and the clause «فلن نزيدكم» is conjoined to the resumptive one; «عذابا» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: «حدائق»: badal (substitute) of {مَفَازًا}, a substitute of the whole for the whole; these very things were made the place of triumph.

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The clause «لا يسمعون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «لحدائق».

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: «جزاء»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the preposition «من ربك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar «جزاء»; «عطاء»: badal (substitute) of «جزاء»; and «حسابا»: naʿt (adjective) of «عطاء», and it is a maṣdar put in the place of the adjective.

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: «رب»: badal (substitute) of {رَبِّكَ}; «ما»: a relative noun conjoined to the earth; «الرحمن»: naʿt (adjective) of the second «رب»; and the clause «لا يملكون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الرحمن».

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: «يوم»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) {يَمْلِكُونَ}; «صفا»: ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause «لا يتكلمون» is a second ḥāl; «مَنْ»: a relative noun, badal (substitute) of the wāw in «يتكلمون»; and «صوابا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: «اليوم» is a badal (substitute); «الحق» is the khabar (predicate) of «ذلك»; and the conditional clause is conjoined to the resumptive one: «ذلك اليوم الحق». The two objects of «اتخذ»: الإيمان (faith), implied, and «مآبا»; the preposition «إلى ربه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «مآبا».

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: «عذابا»: second object; the adverb «يوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second naʿt (adjective) of «عذابا», i.e.: being on the day; «ما»: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «نظر» may be transitive by itself; «يا»: a particle of alerting (tanbīh); and the clause «يقول» is conjoined to the clause «ينظر».
